_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A Return whose lookup finishes after cancel does not navigate. The test seeded a source conversation at /c/{{SOURCE_SLUG}} and a conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). The recorder's lookup of its source conversation (GET /api/conversation-by-slug/<source ID>) is held back until call "releaseLookup"; call "lookupStarted" says ("true" or "false") whether it has arrived. Eval window.__watchReturnRead() makes the page set the body's data-recording-return-read attribute to "true" once it has read the JSON of a later conversation-by-slug response. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/{{SOURCE_SLUG}}. The voice button should be enabled; click it.
2. The recording state should become "recording".
3. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The recorder should float.
4. Eval window.__watchReturnRead().
5. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. Call "lookupStarted" until it returns "true".
6. Click the cancel button. No recording panel should remain (count 0).
7. Call "releaseLookup".
Wait for JSON consumption, not merely the response headers. The lookup's awaiting continuation runs before the next browser assertion.
8. The body should get data-recording-return-read "true".
9. The voice button should be enabled, and the URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
